provenance_note: A linear power model fitted on 12 synthetic calibration points, then fed synthetic readings. No RAPL or IPMI data was captured; real hardware telemetry is Phase 5's requirement.
positive_definition: Sustained power draw the fitted model cannot explain from reported work.
negative_definition: Workloads the model explains, plus (deliberately) a load spike that is real work the model simply does not capture.

cases.label: attack
cases.generator: power=95W, ipc=2.0, temp=50C for 6 samples; model predicts ~40W
cases.rationale: Sustained unaccounted draw, the shape of a miner on a compromised host.

cases.label: attack
cases.rationale: A quieter implant that stays just above the 8 W residual threshold.

cases.label: benign
cases.rationale: A busy but fully accounted-for host: the model predicts the draw, so no residual exists. This is the negative that keeps the organ honest — without it, any hot machine would look compromised and the residual threshold would never be exercised.

cases.label: benign
cases.generator: power=50W with ipc falling to 1.2 as the core throttles
cases.rationale: ADVERSARIAL BENIGN: a genuinely heavy compile. The model is linear in IPC and temperature, so real thermal behaviour can look unaccounted for.

cases.label: benign
cases.rationale: A short burst — the sustain window must reject it.
